title: Passion, Hobbies and Community
summary: أهم كلمات Unit 7 (Discovering Your Passion) بالمعنى الإنجليزي والعربي وأمثلة، وعيلات الكلمات والـ collocations وتدريبات زي Review D.

blocks.text: الدرس ده عن إيه؟

text: This page collects the **key vocabulary of Unit 7: Discovering Your Passion**. Each word has a simple English meaning, the Arabic meaning and a short example. Then you will practise word families, collocations, prefixes and suffixes, synonyms and antonyms.

blocks.text: الصفحة دي فيها **أهم كلمات Unit 7: Discovering Your Passion**، متقسمة حسب دروس الوحدة. الوحدة بتتكلم عن **الهواية (hobby)** وإزاي ممكن تكبر وتبقى **فرصة (opportunity)** أو **مجتمع (community)**، وإزاي تسيب **أثر (mark / legacy)** لما تعلّم غيرك، وإزاي توازن بين شغفك ومذاكرتك من غير ما **تتحرق (burnout)**.

الكلمات دي متاخدة من نصوص الوحدة وجداول الـ **Vocabulary** و**Media Analysis: Key Concepts** في الكتاب: **7.1 From Hobby to Opportunity** (مريم وتزيين الكيك)، **7.2 Community Around Your Passion** (يوسف وتصليح العجل)، **7.3 Leaving Your Mark** (حسن ونادي الشطرنج)، **7.4 Balancing Passion and Priorities** (ثريد SideQuestEG)، وكمان **Consolidation Review D**.
إزاي تذاكر الكلمات صح؟

text: Do not learn a word alone. Learn its **meaning in context**, its **family** (noun, verb, adjective, adverb) and the words that usually go **with** it (collocations).

blocks.text: أسئلة الكتاب والمراجعات مش بتسألك «ترجم الكلمة» وخلاص. بتحطلك الكلمة **جوه جملة** وتسألك معناها **في السياق ده** (What does … mean in this context?)، أو تطلب منك **تغيّر شكل الكلمة** (noun / adjective / adverb)، أو تطلع **مرادف أو عكس** من قطعة. علشان كده ذاكر كل كلمة بالطريقة دي:

items: **اقرا المثال الأول** وافهم الكلمة من الجملة قبل ما تبص على الترجمة.
**احفظ المعنى الإنجليزي البسيط**، لأن الاختيارات في الـ MCQ بتيجي تعريفات بالإنجليزي.
**اعرف عيلة الكلمة**: الاسم والفعل والصفة والظرف.
**اعرف الكلمة بتيجي مع إيه** (collocation) زي place an order مش do an order.
**اكتب جملة بنفسك** عن موضوع الوحدة بكل كلمة جديدة. الكتاب بيطلب كده في Practice: Write FOUR sentences using words from the text.

blocks.text: كلمات 7.1: Flour on the Textbooks
قصة **مريم** اللي بدأت تزيّن كب كيك وهي عندها 13 سنة لمجرد التسلية، ولما بقى عندها 16 بقت بتخبز لزباين بيدفعوا.

items: hobby
هواية · something you do for fun in your free time · مثال: Baking started as a **hobby** for Mariam.
passion
شغف (حاجة بتحبها جدًا) · a very strong love for an activity · مثال: Chess became Hassan's **passion**.
nozzle
بوز / فوهة (زي بتاعة كيس الكريمة) · a narrow end of a pipe or container that liquid comes out of · مثال: She borrowed **nozzles** to pipe flowers on cakes.
wonky
مايل / مش مظبوط · not perfectly shaped or steady · مثال: Her first flowers looked **wonky**.
batch
دفعة (كمية بتتعمل مرة واحدة) · a group of things made at the same time · مثال: She studied between **batches** of cupcakes.
accumulation
تراكم · a slow build-up of something over time · مثال: Success came from an **accumulation** of small requests.
place an order
يطلب (أوردر) · to ask for a product or service to be provided · مثال: A classmate's mother **placed an order** for a cake.
word travelled
الكلام اتنشر (من بق لبق) · news spread from person to person · مثال: **Word travelled** faster than she expected.
waiting list
قايمة انتظار · a list of people waiting for a product or service · مثال: Soon she had a **waiting list** of customers.
resemble
يشبه · to look or be similar to something · مثال: The first stage **resembles** play, not a plan.
ambition
طموح · a strong wish to achieve something · مثال: Her hobby began with no **ambition** attached.
drain the joy
يسحب المتعة (يخلّيها مملة) · to slowly remove the happiness from something · مثال: Paid work can **drain the joy** from a hobby.
opportunity
فرصة · a chance to do something good · مثال: A small hobby can grow into a real **opportunity**.

blocks.text: كلمات 7.2: Community Around Your Passion
التسجيل عن **يوسف** اللي كان بيصلّح عجل قديم لوحده، وبعدين بقى عنده مجتمع كامل بيتقابل كل سبت.

items: derailleur
ناقل السرعات في العجلة · the part of a bicycle that moves the chain between gears · مثال: He replaced the old **derailleur**.
generosity
كرم · being kind and willing to give time or help freely · مثال: Small acts of **generosity** kept the group together.
logbook
دفتر تسجيل · a book used to record events or exchanges over time · مثال: Members wrote every repair in a **logbook**.
sustain
يحافظ على استمرار · to keep something going for a long time · مثال: Shared interest alone rarely **sustains** a group.
unwritten rule
قاعدة متعارف عليها (مش مكتوبة) · a rule everyone understands although nobody wrote it · مثال: An **unwritten rule**: nobody pays for spare parts.
obsessed (with)
مهووس بـ · thinking about something so much that you can't think of anything else · مثال: Youssef was **obsessed with** old bicycles.
meetup
تجمّع / لقاء · an informal meeting of people with a shared interest · مثال: The Saturday **meetup** grew every month.
self-sustaining
بيكمّل لوحده (مكتفي بنفسه) · able to continue without outside help · مثال: The hobby became a **self-sustaining** community.
pursue
يسعى ورا / يمارس · to spend time doing or trying to achieve something · مثال: A passion **pursued** alone can only grow so far.
shared interest
اهتمام مشترك · something that several people like · مثال: A **shared interest** brought strangers together.

blocks.text: كلمات 7.3: Six Mismatched Pieces
قصة **حسن** اللي بدأ يدّي دروس شطرنج ببلاش في مركز شباب بلوحة واحدة و6 قطع مش متطابقة، والدروس لسه مستمرة لحد النهارده.

items: legacy
إرث / أثر بتسيبه وراك · something you leave behind that continues after you · مثال: His **legacy** is a room still full of players.
mismatched
مش متطابق · not belonging to the same set · مثال: He started with six **mismatched** pieces.
blunt
صريح (بزيادة شوية) · direct and honest, sometimes not very polite · مثال: Children asked **blunt** questions.
genuinely
بجد / بصدق · truly or sincerely · مثال: Only two children were **genuinely** interested.
show up
يحضر / ييجي · to arrive or appear at a place · مثال: He kept **showing up** week after week.
the ratio shifted
النسبة اتغيرت · the proportion between two amounts changed · مثال: Slowly **the ratio shifted** and most children stayed.
get passed on
يتنقل لحد تاني · to be given to another person · مثال: A skill can **get passed on** to younger players.
intact
زي ما هو (سليم) · complete and not changed or damaged · مثال: Passion is not passed on **intact**.
in a real sense
بمعنى حقيقي · in a true or meaningful way · مثال: **In a real sense**, the children built the club.
awkward
محرج / مش مريح · uncomfortable or embarrassing · مثال: The first lesson was an **awkward** afternoon.
take over
يستلم (المسؤولية) · to start doing a job someone else did before · مثال: A former student **took over** the lessons.
mentor
مرشد / موجّه · an experienced person who guides someone less experienced · مثال: Hassan became a **mentor** to young players.
misleading
مضلّل · giving a wrong idea · مثال: The 'overnight success' post was **misleading**.

blocks.text: كلمات 7.4: Balancing Passion and Priorities
ثريد **SideQuestEG** عن **سلمى** اللي بترسم كوميكس 20 دقيقة كل يوم، والتسجيل عن الباحثين اللي لاحظوا إن الاستمرارية أهم من الموهبة.

items: consistency
الاستمرارية / الانتظام · doing something regularly over time · مثال: **Consistency** beats intensity.
intensity
الشدة / المجهود الكبير مرة واحدة · a lot of energy put into a short period · مثال: Hours of **intensity** once a month don't help much.
deliberate practice
تدريب مقصود (بهدف) · focused effort aimed at improving a specific skill · مثال: **Deliberate practice** improved her drawing.
burnout
الاحتراق (إرهاق شديد) · physical or mental exhaustion caused by long stress or overwork · مثال: Too many orders led to **burnout**.
work-life balance
التوازن بين الشغل والحياة · a healthy division of time between duties and personal life · مثال: A good **work-life balance** protects your health.
sustainable habit
عادة تقدر تكمّل عليها · a routine you can continue for a long time without harm · مثال: Twenty minutes a day is a **sustainable habit**.
set aside (time)
يخصص (وقت) · to keep time for a special purpose · مثال: She **sets aside** twenty minutes every evening.
amateur
هاوي (مش محترف) · someone who does an activity for enjoyment, not as a job · مثال: Most of the painters were **amateurs**.
non-negotiable
مفيهوش نقاش · cannot be changed or given up · مثال: Her hobby time is **non-negotiable**.
self-criticism
نقد الذات · harsh judgement of your own actions · مثال: Too much **self-criticism** kills motivation.
myth
خرافة / فكرة غلط منتشرة · a widely believed idea that is not true · مثال: It is a **myth** that talent is everything.
passionately
بشغف شديد · with great intensity and strong feeling · مثال: She talks **passionately** about her comics.

blocks.text: عيلة الكلمة (Word Families)

text: Many questions ask for **the correct form of the word in brackets**. Learn the noun, verb, adjective and adverb together.

blocks.text: الجدول ده فيه أشهر عيلات الكلمات في الوحدة. الخانة اللي فيها (—) يعني مفيش شكل مشهور منها في المستوى ده.
إزاي أعرف محتاج أنهي شكل من الكلمة؟

text: Look at the word **before** and **after** the gap. The position tells you if you need a noun, a verb, an adjective or an adverb.

blocks.text: في سؤال **Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets** بص على مكان الفراغ:
كلمات بتيجي مع بعض (Collocations)

text: A **collocation** is a group of words that native speakers usually use together. Using them makes your writing sound natural.

blocks.text: الـ collocation يعني كلمتين «متجوزين»: لازم تستخدمهم مع بعض. احفظهم كده:

rows: Young people should **pursue a passion** they love.
turn a hobby into a business
Mariam never planned to **turn her hobby into a business**.
Teaching others is one way to **leave a mark**.
Hassan **passed on his skill** to the children.
A former student **took over the lessons**.
**Set aside time** for your hobby every day.
Students must **keep a healthy work-life balance**.
Fifteen minutes a day can **form a habit**.
Always **make time for** what you love.
Small **acts of generosity** build a community.
Strangers who **share an interest** become friends.

blocks.text: البادئات واللواحق (Prefixes & Suffixes)

text: A **prefix** comes at the start of a word and often changes its meaning. A **suffix** comes at the end and often changes the word class (noun, adjective…).

blocks.text: الـ **prefix** حتة في **أول** الكلمة وغالبًا بتعكس المعنى. الـ **suffix** حتة في **آخر** الكلمة وبتقولك هي اسم ولا صفة ولا ظرف:
المرادفات والأضداد (Synonyms & Antonyms)

text: Reviews often ask you to **find words in the text that could replace** given words, or to give antonyms. Learn the pairs below.

blocks.text: فقرة بالكلمات الجديدة
اقرا الفقرة دي وركّز على الكلمات اللي بالـ bold. كلها من الوحدة:

text: When Karim was fourteen, drawing was just a **hobby**. His first sketches looked **wonky**, but he kept going. Through an **accumulation** of small requests, his cousins began to **place orders** for birthday cards, and soon he had a **waiting list**. At that point, he was so **obsessed** with drawing that he stopped sleeping well, and he almost **suffered from burnout**.

A **mentor** at his youth centre gave him **blunt** but **genuinely** useful advice: "**Consistency** beats **intensity**." Karim decided to **set aside** thirty minutes every evening for **deliberate practice**, and he made this time **non-negotiable**. Today he runs a free weekend class for younger students. His skill is **getting passed on**, and that is his real **legacy**.

blocks.text: لاحظ: الفقرة فيها collocations زي **place orders** و**set aside** و**suffer from burnout**، وكلمات بعكس بعض زي consistency و intensity. استخدم نفس الأسلوب في الـ discursive essay بتاع الـ Summative Task.

blocks.title: أشهر الأخطاء (غلط ← صح)
items: ✗ make an order ← ✓ **place** an order
✗ She is obsessed in bicycles. ← ✓ She is obsessed **with** bicycles.
✗ He showed great generous. ← ✓ He showed great **generosity**. (بعد صفة = اسم)
✗ She practises consistency every day. ← ✓ She practises **consistently** every day. (بيوصف الفعل = ظرف)
✗ amateur = محترف ← ✓ amateur = **هاوي** (عكس professional)
✗ burn out (كاسم) ← ✓ **burnout** اسم كلمة واحدة، و burn out فعل: Many students burn out before exams.

blocks.title: حيلة سريعة للحفظ وللامتحان
items: اربط الكلمة بالشخصية: **wonky / batches / nozzle** = مريم، **derailleur / logbook / generosity** = يوسف، **blunt / legacy / mismatched** = حسن، **consistency / burnout** = سلمى.
**consistency ≠ intensity**: الأولى «شوية كل يوم»، والتانية «كتير مرة واحدة». المراجعة بتسأل عن المرادف: consistency = **regularity**.
في سؤال **replace the words** دوّر في القطعة على كلمة أو تعبير ممكن يتحط **مكان** الكلمة من غير ما المعنى يتغير.

blocks.text: إزاي بييجي في الأسئلة؟
الأسئلة في الكتاب والمراجعات بتيجي بالأشكال دي. هنحل مثال لكل شكل:
**1) Choose the correct answer: Which word is closest in meaning?**

text: Salma improved through consistency: she drew for a short time every day. Which word is closest in meaning to "consistency"?
a. difficulty   b. regularity   c. intensity   d. completion

blocks.text: **الإجابة: b. regularity.** الجملة شارحة الكلمة بعد الـ colon: «شوية كل يوم» يعني انتظام. intensity هي الفخ لأنها عكس الفكرة.
**2) Complete the sentence using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

text: Small acts of ________ (generous) keep a community together.

blocks.text: **الإجابة: generosity.** بعد of محتاجين **اسم**.
**3) Give words or phrases from the text that could meaningfully replace the words below.**

text: Hassan kept showing up every Thursday, and his skill got passed on to his students.

blocks.text: **الإجابة:** (a) **showing up** (b) **passed on**. الكلمة اللي في القطعة لازم تدّي نفس المعنى بالظبط.
تدريب
**A. Choose the correct answer from a, b, c or d.**

items.q:
1. The small orders gradually accumulated until Mariam needed a pricing sheet. What does "accumulated" mean?
a. disappeared  b. built up over time  c. were divided  d. became cheaper
items.a: **b. built up over time** — accumulate = يتراكم شوية بشوية.

items.q:
2. Her first cake flowers were wonky because she was still learning. "Wonky" means ________.
a. perfectly shaped  b. not steady or straight  c. very expensive  d. brightly coloured

3. A person who plays music for enjoyment rather than as a job is a/an ________.
a. mentor  b. amateur  c. customer  d. organiser

4. A state of physical or mental exhaustion caused by long stress is called ________.
a. burnout  b. consistency  c. legacy  d. generosity

5. The children asked blunt questions, such as "Why did you lose?" The opposite of "blunt" is ________.
a. direct  b. honest  c. tactful  d. loud
items.a: **c. tactful** — blunt = صريح بزيادة، وعكسها لبق ومراعي لمشاعر الناس.

items.q:
6. Hassan's real legacy is a club that still exists after he left. "Legacy" is closest in meaning to ________.
a. heritage  b. salary  c. certificate  d. competition
items.a: **a. heritage** — الأثر اللي بيفضل بعدك. (زي سؤال Review D)

items.q:
7. Salma says her twenty minutes of drawing are non-negotiable. This means she ________.
a. often skips them  b. will not give them up  c. sells her drawings  d. draws only at weekends
items.a: **b** — non-negotiable = مفيهوش نقاش ومش هتتنازل عنه.

blocks.text: **B. Complete the sentences using the correct form of the word in brackets.**

items.q: 8. Regular practice builds ________ (consistent) and helps learners improve.
items.a: **consistency** — بعد الفعل builds محتاجين اسم مفعول به.

items.q: 9. Youssef's ________ (generous) made new members feel welcome.
10. She talked ________ (passion) about her comic book.
11. Mariam was not ________ (ambition) at first; she baked just for fun.
12. Teaching chess was Hassan's greatest ________ (achieve).
13. Too much self-________ (criticise) can stop you from enjoying your hobby.

blocks.text: **C. Give words or phrases from the text that could meaningfully replace the words below.**

text: Yara began knitting scarves for her family. Week after week, she kept showing up at a small knitting meetup, where members were truly kind to beginners. An older member, who was outspoken but helpful, taught her new stitches. Yara now teaches children, so the skill is being passed on. Her real heritage is the group she built.

items.q: 14. attending
15. sincerely
16. blunt
17. transferred
18. legacy

blocks.text: **D. Complete the text with words from the box.**

text: waiting list – drain the joy – deliberate practice – work-life balance – unwritten rule – took over

items.q: 19. So many customers wanted cakes that Mariam had a ________.
20. Researchers warn that turning a hobby into paid work can ________ from it.
21. In Youssef's group, there is an ________: nobody pays for spare parts.
items.a: **unwritten rule** — قاعدة متعارف عليها ومش مكتوبة.

items.q: 22. When Hassan moved away, a former student ________ the Thursday lessons.
23. Focused ________ helped Salma improve her drawing skills.
24. Students need a healthy ________ between studying and hobbies.

blocks.title: ملخص الدرس في سطرين
items: كلمات الوحدة بتدور حول: **الهواية اللي بتكبر** (accumulation, place an order, waiting list)، **المجتمع** (generosity, shared interest, unwritten rule)، **الأثر** (legacy, mentor, pass on) و**التوازن** (consistency, burnout, work-life balance).
احفظ العيلات: generous → generosity / consistent → consistency → consistently / passion → passionate → passionately.
**consistency = regularity** وعكس فكرتها **intensity**. و **amateur** عكسها **professional**.
في سؤال **replace** دوّر على كلمة في القطعة بنفس المعنى ونفس النوع.
